none: PAS FindID 1013584: Roman Guiraud Type 3 Finger Ring
contea di ritrovamento: Suffolk (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete Roman copper-alloy finger ring dating to AD 43-40. It consists of the bezel and one surviving portion of the shoulder and hoop. The bezel is circular in plan, 3.3mm thick, and does not contain space for a setting. The surface is heavily worn but is inscribed with six S-shaped designs, layed out in two rows of three.
